errors.boardChanged: The board changed. Select a highlighted coin again.
errors.signInToRejoin: Sign in to rejoin your online game.
errors.notConfigured: Online play is not configured in this build.
errors.teamRoomFailed: Could not create your team room. Try again.
errors.createFailed: Could not create the game. Try again.

play.title: Online play
play.subtitle: PLAY WITH PEOPLE
play.noServer: This build has no game server configured, so online play is not available. Offline games work as usual.

unavailable.title: Play Online is unavailable
unavailable.offline: No internet connection. Online play returns the moment you are back online; offline games are always ready.
unavailable.server: The game server is not answering right now. Try again in a moment, or play offline meanwhile.

choose.title: Choose how to play
choose.subtitle: ONLINE PLAY
choose.heading: Jump straight in, or bring your account
choose.body: Guests can play online right away. An account adds friends, challenges, your game history and progress that follows you between devices.

tournament.title: Weekly tournament
tournament.body: Every game +1 point, every win +3. Free tables pay up to +{{coins}} coins by finish; staked tables pay the pot.

quick.title: Quick Play
quick.keepOpen: Keep this screen open. Leaving cancels your search, and the other players are strangers who will not wait.
quick.seatedWith: You are seated with the next players looking for the same table.

teams.title: 2 v 2 teams
teams.body: Partners sit opposite, never capture each other, and win together.
teams.randomHint: Play with three players from the queue
teams.randomBody: Four players from the queue. Your partner is picked for you.
teams.friendHint: Get a code for your friend, then find another team together
teams.friendBody: Send your friend a code. Together you play another team of friends.
teams.usesAbove: Uses the game mode and entry you picked above.

more.title: More ways to play
more.challengeGuest: Create an account to add friends and challenge them.
more.challengeMember: Pick one or two friends for a private table.
more.privateA11y: Create a private game or join with a code
more.privateBody: Invite anyone with a link, or join with a code.

guest.label: PLAYING AS A GUEST
guest.played_one: You’ve played {{count}} game as a guest.
guest.played_other: You’ve played {{count}} games as a guest.
guest.likeIt: Like it here? Make it yours.
guest.body: Create an account to save your game history, keep your coins and progress, and add friends. Nothing you have played is lost.

private.title: Private game
private.body: Pick the table size. You will get a link and a code to send to anyone.
private.codeHint: Type the six-character code, or paste the whole invite message.

status.connectionLost: Connection lost. Reconnecting… your seat is kept.
status.reconnectingServer: Reconnecting to the server… your seat is kept.
status.reconnectingTable: Reconnecting to your table. Your turn will resume when connected.
status.outOfLifelines: You ran out of lifelines. Your turns are skipped - watch or leave the table.
status.someoneLeft: Someone left. The game has ended.
status.playable_one: {{count}} playable coin - tap a bouncing coin
status.playable_other: {{count}} playable coins - tap a bouncing coin
status.onlyOne: Only one move - playing it for you...
status.noMoves: No moves this time. Passing the dice…
status.yourTurnLives: Your turn - roll before the clock runs out ({{lives}} ♥ left)
status.rollForPartner: Your coins are home - roll for your partner!
status.yourTurn: Your turn - tap the dice to roll

leave.title: Leave this match?
leave.stakeLost: Your {{amount}}-coin stake stays in the pot and you get no prize.
leave.noCoins: You get no coins for this game and it counts as a loss.
leave.partnerLoses: Your partner loses with you, and the other pair wins.
leave.othersPlayOn: The others keep playing without you.

match.pauseBody: The other players are still at the table. Leaving forfeits this game — they play on, or win it outright at a table of two.

subtitle.abandoned: Someone left, so the match ended early
subtitle.lostRival: Your rival took this one · rematch?

note.vault: +{{amount}} coins are waiting in your vault — sign in any time to claim everything in it.
note.earn: Create an account to earn {{amount}} coins for every online win.
note.poolSplit: The players who stayed split the prize pool. It is added to your coins when you continue.

match.share: I just beat real players in a {{mode}} game of Ludo Rumble! 🎲🏆

lobby.title: Game lobby
lobby.signInToJoin: Sign in to join this game.

closed.linkBody: Invite links stay open for 30 minutes. Start a new private game and share the fresh link.
closed.expiredBody: The invitation timed out. Start a fresh challenge whenever you are ready.
closed.quickBody: Quick-play tables only start with everyone present. Search again and you will be seated with the next players.
closed.cancelledBody: Everyone invited has been told. You can set up another game any time.

invite.label: INVITE YOUR PLAYERS
invite.waitingMore_one: Waiting for {{count}} more. Anyone with the link or code can take a seat.
invite.waitingMore_other: Waiting for {{count}} more. Anyone with the link or code can take a seat.

lobby.teamsNote: 2 v 2 teams: the player opposite you is your partner.
lobby.seeking: Looking for another team of friends… Random 2 v 2 players can fill in after 20 seconds.

footer.waitingReady: Waiting for players to be ready…

hostHint.inviteMore: Invite two more friends, or keep the other side empty to find opponents.
hostHint.whenJoins: When your friend joins they sit opposite you as your partner. Then find opponents, or invite two more friends.

cancelSheet.title: Cancel game?
cancelSheet.body: All invited players will be told the game is off.

banner.title: Get ready
banner.body: Everyone starts at the same moment, timed by the server.

join.title: Join a game
join.subtitle: INVITE LINK
join.noServer: This build has no game server configured, so invite links cannot be used.
join.invalidTitle: That link does not have a valid code
join.invalidBody: Ask your friend to share the invite again, or enter the code on the Online tab.
join.invitedBody: Join as a guest right away, or sign in to play with your account.

tournament.title: Weekly Tournament
tournament.subtitle: ONLINE LEAGUE
tournament.signInBody: Every online match scores points. Sign in to take part and win coins and gems when the week ends.
tournament.relegated: Relegated to {{league}}. This week is the comeback.
tournament.top: The top of the ladder. {{bonus}}+ points this week pays {{gems}} gems.
tournament.topDemote: The top of the ladder. {{bonus}}+ points this week pays {{gems}} gems; under {{below}} drops you to {{league}}.
tournament.scoring: Online matches score {{win}} points for a win and {{played}} for finishing. Prizes are paid when the week closes.
tournament.empty: Nobody has scored yet this week. Win an online match to take first place.

matchmaking.allFilled: All seats filled — taking you to the table…
matchmaking.hint: Keep this screen open — leaving cancels your search.
